speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are home at an hour when a playing man is often not. Sit. I am not asking you to be interesting about it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not in the afternoon. The Shrew goes up without me. That is the whole of the programme, Mistress.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is a penny, and it is a full thumb short of the notch. I looked before you latched the door. The jaw is well enough for the end piece, if the end piece is wanted.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The jaw is well. I will eat. I will not explain the morning, and I will not explain a boy.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not. I have no appetite for other people's troubles told at my board as if they were a plot. Threepence, and the crust if you want it, and your own business kept.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Kept. There is a sheet upstairs with a word on it I am not striking. That is as much as the house will get, and it is too much if it leads to questions.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will not ask the word. I asked the loaf, and the loaf has answered. Gib is on the stair, not on the papers.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him the stair. The red bundle is tied, and a loose leaf is not his dinner. Nor is it yours to tidy.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. I tidy what is left in my hall. I do not tidy a man's verse, and I do not mend a latch because he has come home in a mood. Eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating. The mood can stay in the yard where I left it. The afternoon is free, and I mean to spend it at this table without becoming a story.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is broth as well as the end piece. A well jaw can still prefer the cup. I heated it when I heard the latch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The end piece and the cup. You are right that well is not the same as fierce. I am well. I am not fierce.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Fierce is for people with a parish to scold. You have an afternoon off a stage. Use it like a man who pays his board before noon on quarter day, which you do, and which I mention so you will remember I notice the quiet ones.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I remember. Quarter day is not today. Today is a loaf and a play I am not in.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I air the cloak? The frost was on you when you came through. It is off you now.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Air it. I am not going back. Whoever is in the Shrew can have the cold yard. I have had my morning of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. If anyone comes asking for a tale of the morning, I shall say you ate. It will be true, and it will be dull, and dull is a charity.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Dull is exactly the charity I want. Thank you. I will not repay it with a confidence.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will take the notch-end of the loaf for the comparison, and put it back in the crock. The thumb's shortness does not need an audience.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It has had its audience all autumn. It can rest. So can I, until the light goes and I look at a word I already know I am keeping.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Look at it upstairs, when you look. One candle, and it is yours. The hall is not a scriptorium because a man is home early.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will shut the stair against Gib if he starts for the table. A cat is not a partner either.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut it if you must. He has the Holinshed when he wants a book, and the Holinshed is shut.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we are agreed. Dinner is dinner. The afternoon can be long without being narrated.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One candle. I know the division. And I know better than to make you a partner in a line you did not ask to hear.
